column1: # screen field batch 11: GameScreen, slice 3 - the frame loop state, the AI ticker and the
# frame loop: sessionStartTime (e, set in createGlResources and consumed by dispose() to add
#   (now - e)/1000 to UserConfig.playingTime); loadingComplete (j, set once BackgroundTask.isDone()
#   and the scene moves from GameScene.e to f, and used to gate both "center camera on my player"
#   and the hotkeys); frameCount (Q, ++ every render and used as a blink phase, (Q & 0xF) == 0);
#   lastTapTime/doubleTap (x/y, y = now - x < 0.4s, i.e. the double-tap test); pointerHeld (z, set on
#   press and read by the 1-second long-press branch); keyboardScrolling (cc, set only in the
#   "MoveMap" key-scroll branch); actionKeyCode (cg, the UserConfig.getActionKey* value currently
#   pressed, -1 when none); pointerDown (bN, the cached isTouchDown/left-button state).
# camera: targetCameraZoom (P, cameraZoom follows it and both start at 1.0f).
#   aiUpdateCount % length].update(); ++aiUpdateCount; }` - at most 30 planner updates per second.
# spectatingSince (l, Float.MAX_VALUE until the first frame the game mode no longer contains the
#   local player, then gameTime; read for 2 seconds afterwards to shake the camera) and
#   escortTargetArea (m, EscortMode.getTargetArea(), drawn as a marker).
# buffers: fogVertexBuffer/fogIndexBuffer (aU/aV, written by updateFogOfWarGeometry and bound before
#   the fog pass) and markerVertexBuffer/markerIndexBuffer (aW/aX, the dynamic geometry for the
#   guard/click markers). playerColors (a) are the eight colors indexed by AI planner in the debug
# Left unnamed: the unused constants b (25), c (0.2f) and d (0.9f) - nothing reads them - and X
